# Percentage

## Summary
Base-realm percentage field — a NumberField subclass that renders its value
as `NN%` (rounded to 2 decimals). Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/percentage` (default export `PercentageField`).

## API
Primitive number. Store `12.5` to display `12.5%` — the value is the
percentage itself, not a 0-1 fraction.

## Usage
```ts
import PercentageField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/percentage';

@field winProbability = contains(PercentageField);
```
Negative values render escaped (`\-NN%`) so a leading minus is not
mistaken for markdown (CS-10786).
